name: RSI pullback in trend
idea: While the higher-timeframe trend filter agrees, a signal when the RSI turns back out of the oversold zone (bullish) or the overbought zone (bearish) after a dip into it; the idea is wrong beyond the dip's extreme.

params.label: RSI period
params.help: Bars the RSI is calculated over.

params.label: Oversold level
params.help: The dip starts when the RSI goes below this level; the signal comes when it is back above.

params.label: Overbought level
params.help: The rally starts when the RSI goes above this level; the signal comes when it is back below.

params.label: Trend filter
params.help: What tells the trend on the higher timeframe: the close against its trend average, or the Supertrend direction.
choice_labels: The close against a trend average

params.label: Trend timeframe
params.help: The higher timeframe the trend filter reads (closed bars only).

params.label: Trend average type
params.help: How the trend average is calculated.

params.label: Supertrend period
params.help: Bars of the average true range behind the Supertrend line.

params.label: Supertrend multiplier
params.help: How many average true ranges the line keeps from the middle of the bar.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: When the RSI reaches the opposite zone, or on the opposite signal (the RSI turning back out of that zone).
choice_labels: The RSI reaches the opposite zone

constraints.message: The trend timeframe must be higher than the signal timeframe.
